callOrder.beforeTemporaryHook: Pose/view and R06 comparison are set; original GPU frame, complete state, solver reports, shader and read-only geometry sample are recorded. surface.install reads compatibility only before attach.
whileAttached: surface.setMode changes only the diagnostic shader/control
capture calls original viewer.render through temporary restored renderer.render observation and performs actual readPixels
surface.report verifies frozen inputs without R06 report
shaderRecord reads actual attached GPU GLSL and pure innerLip.shaderEvidence
actualDiagnosticUniform reads r07EdgeSurfaceMode from current WebGLProgram and checks 1/2
callOrder.restoreOrder: try/finally invokes surface.restore; it detaches the exact compile/cache hooks and descriptors before querying cornerLip/motionLip reports. Then a real restored frame and complete state/shader/solver records are checked.
callOrder.indirectReaderChecked: innerLip.shaderEvidence returns original/final fragment closure strings and cloned nativeUniformIdentity; it does not report, update or render. CornerLip has no periodic sync after its boot interval is cleared; runner pauses idle/playback.

restorationChecks.completeState: Uses deepEqual(finalState, originalState), not the relaxed protectedState helper. Includes native/draw geometry and semantic hashes, canonical buffers, material identities/hooks/parameters, person/pose/settings, native before-local base, calibration, final contact samples, camera and light state.
restorationChecks.callsAndValidity: Deep equality of compact original/restored R05/R06 solver records, including calls, errors, enabled, installed and valid; explicit implementations/comparison checks.
restorationChecks.actualPixels: Exact original/restored raw RGBA SHA-256 for each of the three windows. PNGs are lossless writes from those actual native readbacks.
restorationChecks.actualShader: Exact expanded vertex/fragment source hashes and compiled status, inherited template content and original native uniform ownership/values. Program IDs need not be identical and are not used as a source-content proxy.
restorationChecks.originalHooks: Helper separately checks exact compile/cache function objects, own descriptors, cache value, native diagnostic values and protected inputs.
restorationChecks.diagnosticReality: Requires distinct original/no-bump/albedo framebuffer responses, actual GPU uniform values 1/2, real compile evidence, exactly one added diagnostic uniform and original vertex/native uniform identities retained. Differences establish a response, not image quality.

inheritedVerifierCheck.boundary: These named ranges are exact. The entire R07 runner is intentionally not the original verifier: target constants, QA schema, diagnosis flow and finish receipt differ.

versionAndWorkflow.diagnosticCommit: Recorded separately as GITHUB_SHA; workflow postcheck requires an exact match. The R07 run does not label itself a new product build.
versionAndWorkflow.matrix: Five pose/view tests plus provenance = six tests; jaw macro, jaw oblique and speak macro each have original/no-bump/albedo/restored (12 frames), plus neutral macro and pucker oblique (2 frames).
versionAndWorkflow.transportAndCleanup: Strict request/page/console/resource gates remain after cleanup. Collected transport observations do not erase failed requests. Timeout/failure paths remain incomplete.
versionAndWorkflow.evidenceCommit: Workflow preserves only R07 evidence on the named branch after checking current remote head equals the triggering diagnostic commit; no force push. The resulting evidence commit is distinct from the triggering source and frozen R06 build.
versionAndWorkflow.claims: productionRepair, visualAcceptance, productionReady and shareAllowed remain false for diagnostics even if technical execution succeeds.
